---
title: "Florida Governor Election Results"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    fig-width: 9
    fig-height: 7
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(plotly)

county_results <- read_csv(
  "data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

governor <- county_results |>
  filter(
    office == "Governor",
    !candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes", "WriteinVotes")
  ) |>
  group_by(county, candidate) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(county) |>
  mutate(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    vote_share = votes / total_votes
  ) |>
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(county))

florida_counties <- map_data("county", region = "florida") |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(subregion)) |>
  left_join(governor, by = "county_key")

candidate_colors <- c(
  "DeSantis / Nuñez" = "#1f5b9c",
  "Crist / Hernandez" = "#c43d4b",
  "Roos / Rorabaugh" = "#d49a31"
)
```

## 2022 Florida Governor

```{r}
florida_counties <- florida_counties |>
  mutate(
    map_alpha = replace_na(vote_share, 0.5),
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", str_to_title(subregion), " County</b><br>",
      "Winner: ", replace_na(candidate, "No result"), "<br>",
      "Votes: ", scales::comma(replace_na(votes, 0)), "<br>",
      "Vote share: ", scales::percent(replace_na(vote_share, 0), accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

county_map <- ggplot(florida_counties, aes(long, lat, group = group, text = tooltip)) +
  geom_polygon(
    aes(fill = candidate, alpha = map_alpha),
    color = "#fffdf8",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, expand = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = candidate_colors,
    na.value = "#d9dde3",
    name = "Winner"
  ) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.62, 1), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Florida, county by county",
    subtitle = "Each county is shaded for the candidate with the most votes",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections, 2022 general election"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fbfaf7", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 24,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#18252d",
      margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#52616b", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "#687782", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "#fbfaf7", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(14, 20, 14, 20)
  )

ggplotly(county_map, tooltip = "text") |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

```{r}
governor |>
  group_by(candidate) |>
  summarise(
    votes = sum(votes),
    counties_won = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(votes)) |>
  mutate(vote_share = scales::percent(votes / sum(votes), accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Candidate", "Votes", "Counties won", "Vote share"),
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  )
```
